headlines.en: A digital showroom for every business.

featureGraphic.artDirection: Use the approved MirtPage identity and a restrained composition grounded in a real approved showroom capture. Keep key content central; never invent a screen.

alt.en: A digital showroom with business identity, its story and product range.
alt.am: የንግዱን መለያ፣ ታሪክና ምርቶች በአንድ ላይ የሚያሳይ ዲጂታል ማሳያ።
alt.om: Agarsiisa dijitaalaa maqaa daldalaa, seenaa fi oomishaalee isaa walitti qabu.

alt.en: A showroom product grid with named collection chips and short product descriptions.
alt.am: የምርት ስብስብ ምርጫዎችና አጭር መግለጫ ያላቸውን ምርቶች የሚያሳይ ገጽ።
alt.om: Oomishaalee garee isaanii filachuun ilaaluuf filannoo fi ibsa gabaabaa qabu.

alt.en: Product photos, description, choices and availability listed by the business.
alt.am: የምርቱን ፎቶ፣ መግለጫ፣ ምርጫና ንግዱ ያስቀመጠውን የመገኘት መረጃ የሚያሳይ ገጽ።
alt.om: Suuraa, ibsa, filannoo fi odeeffannoo argama oomishaa daldalichi kaa'e.

alt.en: The business map with clear search controls and a business preview showing its city.
alt.am: የንግድ ካርታ፣ ግልጽ የፍለጋ ቁጥጥሮችና ከተማውን የሚያሳይ የንግድ ቅድመ እይታ።
alt.om: Kaartaa daldalaa, barbaacha fi dursee ilaaluu maqaa magaalaa agarsiisu.

alt.en: Selected products with a prepared inquiry, external contact channels and a manual copy option.
alt.am: የተመረጡ ምርቶች፣ የተዘጋጀ ጥያቄ፣ የንግዱ የውጭ አድራሻዎችና መልዕክት የመቅዳት ምርጫ።
alt.om: Oomishaalee filataman, ergaa gaaffii, karaa quunnamtii alaa fi filannoo waraabuu.

alt.en: Transport chat intake with pickup and destination fields and a link to email-verified Tracking.
alt.am: መነሻና መድረሻ የሚሞላበት የማጓጓዣ ቻትና በኢሜይል ኮድ ወደሚከፈት መከታተያ የሚወስድ ሊንክ።
alt.om: Chaatii geejjibaa bakka ka'umsaa fi ga'umsaa galchan; liinkii Tracking koodii imeeliin banamu.

capturePolicy.source: actual approved new MirtPage Android app
